verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean right-side text column (headline over subtitle, good hierarchy) and a sensible photo crop, but the lightbulb doodle lands right on the man's nose and glasses, and the arrow cuts across his cheek, which are unwanted collisions on the face. In B the 'HOW IT WORKS?' headline sits over his mouth and chin, the doodles (arrow, bulb, question mark, atom) are jammed into one overlapping row across his face, and the subtitle is tiny and stranded in the top-right corner, far from its headline. That breaks hierarchy, grouping and the rule against text over a busy image.
